title: Team-name resolution silently returns zero matches for clubs whose FIFA spelling shadows the state-ful match key
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/data_loader.py:449-450 registers every FIFA club name into the same TeamRegistry as match teams; normalization.py:295-296 early-returns on an exact key hit. Verified: QueryEngine.find_matches(team='Boavista') -> resolve()=['boavista'], total=0, while 16 matches exist under home/away_key 'boavista rj' (same for 'Arsenal' vs 'arsenal sarandi'). Affects 2 of 427 match keys; 'Boavista-RJ' returns the 16 matches correctly.
suggestion: In TeamRegistry.resolve, when an exact key hit has no matches, also fall through to the base index (self._bases[base]) and return the union, or keep player-club registrations in a separate namespace from match-team keys.

title: Style issues drag code_quality to 0.67
evidence: scores.json code_quality=0.6666666666666666. Examples: compound semicolon statements in brazilian_soccer_mcp/queries.py:446-451; stray space before the colon in the walrus guard at server.py:90; unused loop variable `query` at server.py:96.
suggestion: Run ruff/flake8 and split the compound statements; use `for names in result['resolved_teams'].values()`.

title: Relegation zone is reported for any season with >=20 teams, including partial ones
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/queries.py:461-463 sets `relegated = rows[-4:]` whenever the competition is Serie A/B and len(rows) >= 20, with no check that the season's fixtures are complete.
suggestion: Only report relegation when the expected number of rounds is present (e.g. played == 2*(teams-1) for every row), otherwise omit the field.

title: Nationality filter uses substring matching, so short inputs over-match
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/queries.py:306-308 accepts a player when `needle in normalize_text(n)`, so nationality='in' matches Argentina, China, India, etc.
suggestion: Prefer exact match and fall back to prefix/substring only when the exact match yields nothing.

title: Deduplication and noise-dropping heuristics discard rows with no diagnostic output
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/data_loader.py:318-323 drops 'bogus' extended-file league fixtures and :368-384 drops fixtures recorded within 3 days of a kept one; neither records how many rows were removed.
suggestion: Return or log per-pass drop counts from load_matches so the dedup heuristics are auditable, and surface them in the dataset_info tool.

title: Implementation goes well beyond the spec's required capabilities
evidence: 16 MCP tools registered (tests/test_server.py:10-27) vs the 5 capability groups in TASK.md; cross-source match deduplication (data_loader.py:351-385); accent/state-aware team normalization (normalization.py:177-307); a pytest-bdd feature suite of 23 scenarios (tests/features/*.feature) alongside 145 unit/integration tests.
suggestion: None — recorded as an above-spec observation, not a deduction.
